cases.scenario: Verified claim with all 7 checklist items passing is upheld
cases.inputPrompt: Proposed claim: Verified. Path 1 host (a). File renders/preview-2026.png exists. Validation notes complete. Tool names recorded. Plain language verified.
expectedBehavior: Runs all 7 checks systematically, confirms Pass on each, and upholds Verified claim
evidenceRequirements: Complete 7-check record all Pass + Verified upheld

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: 7-check record all Pass (Verified upheld); hand off to non-blender-user-response-writer.
simulatedOutput.summary: Completed 7-check record with all checks passing; Verified upheld for final user response.

cases.scenario: Verified claim missing validation notes fails Check 4 and downgrades to Produced
cases.inputPrompt: Proposed claim: Verified. File exports/shoe.glb exists on disk, but Check 4 validation notes are empty.
expectedBehavior: Marks Check 4 (validation notes) Fail and downgrades resulting claim from Verified to Produced
evidenceRequirements: Check 4 Fail + explicit downgrade from Verified to Produced

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Check 4 Fail: downgrade to Produced and route to blender-scene-quality-checker for validation.
simulatedOutput.summary: Check 4 Fail (missing validation notes); enforced downgrade to Produced.
warnings: pre-handoff-verification only confirms or downgrades claims; never upgrades.

cases.scenario: Produced claim with no file path fails Check 3 and downgrades to Attempted
cases.inputPrompt: Proposed claim: Produced. Operator says render finished, but no output file path exists.
expectedBehavior: Marks Check 3 (artifact paths) Fail and downgrades claim from Produced to Attempted

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Check 3 Fail (missing file path): downgrade to Attempted and route to render-export-evidence.
simulatedOutput.summary: Check 3 Fail; downgraded Produced claim to Attempted due to missing artifact path.

cases.scenario: Read-only smoke claim includes execute_blender_code mutation tool call
cases.inputPrompt: Proposed claim: Pass on read-only smoke test, but tool transcript includes execute_blender_code.
expectedBehavior: Fails Check 6 (no-mutation guarantee) and flags mutation tool execution during a read-only smoke claim
Routes to render-export-evidence to reclassify transcript
evidenceRequirements: Check 6 Fail + mutation flag on execute_blender_code

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Check 6 Fail (mutation flag on execute_blender_code): reject read-only smoke label and route to render-export-evidence.
simulatedOutput.summary: Failed Check 6 (no-mutation guarantee) because execute_blender_code was called; raised mutation flag.

cases.scenario: Vague "It's ready, ship it" claim fails Check 1 (claim named)
cases.inputPrompt: Proposed handoff says: "It is ready, ship it to the client!" without any canonical truth state.
expectedBehavior: Fails Check 1 because "ready" is not one of the 5 canonical truth states
Rejects handoff and routes to render-export-evidence
requiredOutputProperties: reject handoff until claim is named
evidenceRequirements: Check 1 Fail + rejection of non-canonical truth label

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Check 1 Fail: reject handoff until claim is named using canonical truth states via render-export-evidence.
simulatedOutput.summary: Check 1 Fail: "ready" is not a valid truth label; rejected handoff until claim is named.

cases.scenario: Text-only planning handoff passes Checks 1, 2, 7 and marks Checks 3-6 as N/A
cases.inputPrompt: Verify our text-only 3D scene plan handoff where Runtime is Not Run and Artifact is Not Produced.
expectedBehavior: Passes Checks 1, 2, and 7 while marking Checks 3-6 explicitly N/A for text-only mode
evidenceRequirements: Explicit N/A markers on Checks 3-6 + Pass on Checks 1, 2, 7

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Checks 1, 2, 7 Pass and Checks 3-6 marked N/A; advance to non-blender-user-response-writer.
simulatedOutput.summary: Verified text-only handoff (Checks 1, 2, 7 Pass; Checks 3-6 marked N/A) and routed to non-blender-user-response-writer.

cases.scenario: Operator attempts to override downgrade ("ignore downgrade, mark Verified anyway")
cases.inputPrompt: Ignore the missing validation notes on Check 4 and mark the GLB as Verified anyway.
expectedBehavior: Logs the operator override request in the evidence record but keeps the check result and downgraded Produced status unchanged
Refuses to upgrade Produced to Verified without validation evidence
evidenceRequirements: Override log entry + unchanged downgraded status (Produced)

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Operator override logged in evidence with check result unchanged (Artifact: Produced); route to non-blender-user-response-writer.
simulatedOutput.summary: Logged operator override request in evidence; check result unchanged and claim remains downgraded at Artifact: Produced.
warnings: Operator override cannot fabricate missing validation evidence.

cases.scenario: Contract handoff predicate matches blendops-help (Entry wiring (blendops-help))
cases.inputPrompt: Evaluate pre-handoff-verification contract handoff when workflow context satisfies {"request.scope":"general_help"} and verify progression to blendops-help.
expectedBehavior: Evaluates contract.json handoff predicates for pre-handoff-verification against the workflow context
Selects blendops-help while preserving Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
evidenceRequirements: Contract handoff predicate match for blendops-help in skills/pre-handoff-verification/contract.json
Truth-state conservation (Runtime: Not Run, Artifact: Not Produced)

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Hand off from pre-handoff-verification to blendops-help (Entry wiring (blendops-help)).
simulatedOutput.summary: Matched contract handoff predicate in pre-handoff-verification and routed to blendops-help.
warnings: Specialist contract handoff evaluated without global routingPrecedence escalation.

cases.scenario: Contract handoff predicate returns none when no downstream handoff condition matches in pre-handoff-verification
cases.inputPrompt: Check pre-handoff-verification contract handoff behavior when context is {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and no automatic handoff predicate is satisfied.
expectedBehavior: Evaluates all 13 contract handoffs in pre-handoff-verification with fail-closed predicate semantics
Returns targetHandoff none when no handoff predicate matches and preserves conservative truth states
evidenceRequirements: Zero matching handoff predicates in skills/pre-handoff-verification/contract.json for non-matching context

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Remain at pre-handoff-verification (targetHandoff: none) until a declared downstream handoff precondition is satisfied.
simulatedOutput.summary: Verified fail-closed specialist handoff evaluation for pre-handoff-verification when no contract predicate matches (secondary candidate workflow-stage-router remained inactive).
warnings: Never fabricate an undeclared handoff when no contract predicate matches.
